meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 dial 命令行使用一个已配好的真实电话号码:发短信、拨打由 AI 语音代理接听的电话,以及等待收到的短信或验证码。命令都支持 --json 输出,方便解析结果。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、语音等关键词,或要求发短信、打电话、等验证码时触发;一个会话里首次运行 dial 命令前也应先加载本技能。

say.text: 用 dial 给 +14155550123 发条短信:我五分钟后到
say.note: 发送一条 SMS,可加 --json 解析结果

say.text: 给 +14155550123 打个 AI 语音电话,确认今晚的预约
say.note: 结束后用 dial call get 取通话结果

say.text: 等一条 SMS 验证码,收到后把验证码告诉我

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use the dial CLI with a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and wait for inbound texts or verification codes. Commands support --json output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP or 2FA codes, ask to text or call someone or wait for a code, or before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.text: Use dial to text +14155550123: I'll be there in five minutes
say_en.note: Sends an SMS; add --json to parse the result

say_en.text: Place an AI voice call to +14155550123 to confirm tonight's booking
say_en.note: Then run dial call get to fetch the outcome

say_en.text: Wait for an SMS verification code and tell me the code
